name: @arcs/slop-gate
description: Four-layer slop-free / factuality gate for customer-facing surfaces: style lint, human-baseline metrics, LLM judgment, and evidence-ledger provenance. Stdlib-only Python, shelled from a thin CLI.
engineNote: Runtime prerequisite NOT expressible in engines: python3 >= 3.8 must be on PATH. The linters are Python; this package shells to them (see README 'Why python3, not a JS port').
licenseNote: UNLICENSED = license undecided; the user picks it at publish. Recommended: MIT (matches the sibling resume-tailor-skill and the 'public good' framing), but that is the user's call.
author: Zach Harris (ARCS)
